icon.$description: Component tier: tokens named per-component, for the cases a component needs a value distinct from its semantic default (BR-BW-TOK-001, tier 3). Theme-agnostic (they reference semantic colour tokens, which already resolve per theme, or fixed sizes). Most components consume semantic tokens directly and need nothing here; this set is deliberately small.

font.$description: Typography tokens (semver-public, brand-overridable). Theme-agnostic. A consuming app rebrands its typeface the same token-first way it rebrands colour, by overriding --bw-font-family-* rather than reaching into brickwork's own classes. The default stack is a neutral system-font stack so an unbranded install still looks intentional.

sans.$value: system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif

mono.$value: ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, 'SF Mono', Menlo, Consolas, 'Liberation Mono', monospace
